title: Surplus food marketplace
summary: Buy restaurants' and shops' surplus food at a discount.
whyTempting: Food waste is huge and everyone hates it.
whyItFails: Unpredictable supply. Users can't rely on what's available. Thin margins. Discounted food leaves little to share. Merchant effort. Listing surplus is extra work at closing time.
whatWouldChange: POS integration that lists surplus automatically.

attempts.notes: Surplus food bags from shops and restaurants; claimed 62 million users in 2023. One of the few that made it work.

attempts.outcome: Closed after failing to raise funds

reasons.detail: Unpredictable supply: Users can't rely on what's available.
Thin margins: Discounted food leaves little to share.
Merchant effort: Listing surplus is extra work at closing time.
